address: 654-656 Wisut Kasat Road, Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok, 10200, Thailand
bio: For over half a century, unwavering quality and rare dishes have kept loyal fans visiting this traditional Thai-Chinese spot, which is now run by the third generation of the same family. Among the top-sellers are crab omelette and stir-fried beef with cumin leaves. Crowds are to be expected, so make sure you book to avoid disappointment. It’s closed on weekends and holidays....
